## Project Structure Summary

**Framework & Router:** 
- **Next.js 16.4.0** with **App Router** (file-based routing in `/app` directory)
- React 19.3.0 with TypeScript
- **next-themes** for theme switching

**Route/Pages Organization:**
- Routes located in `/app` directory using Next.js App Router convention:
  - `/app/page.tsx` - Homepage with hero section and pricing grid
  - `/app/dashboard/page.tsx` - Dashboard page showing activity
  - `/app/layout.tsx` - Root layout wrapping all pages
- Routes are file-based: `app/[path]/page.tsx` becomes `/[path]`

**Root Layout Structure** (`/app/layout.tsx`):
- Global header with navigation (Home, Dashboard, Theme toggle)
- **ThemeProvider** from `next-themes` for dark/light mode
- Custom fonts loaded via `next/font/google` (Bricolage Grotesque, Google Sans Flex, Host Grotesk)
- Font roles mapped to design system tokens in `globals.css`
- `{children}` wrapped inside ThemeProvider

**Existing Pattern Pages:**
- **Dashboard page** (`/app/dashboard/page.tsx`) - Shows a good pattern with:
  - Title + subtitle sections
  - DropdownMenu + DropdownTrigger for filters
  - Responsive layout with flex/grid utilities
  - Empty state message

**Design System (@dooph-software/design-system v5.3.0):**
Major component categories available:
- **Text Components:** BaseText, BodyText, ButtonText, HeadingText, TitleText, SubheadingText, LabelText, HeroText, HeroBodyText, MonoText
- **Input Components:** Input, Checkbox, SegmentedTabSelect, Slider variants, DatePicker, VerificationCodeInput
- **Buttons:** Button, CTAButton, CopyButton, OutlineButton, ShapeButton, SplitButton
- **Navigation:** Tabs, DropdownMenu, DropdownTrigger, Popover, Sheet, Modal
- **Layout:** Table, OutlineSection, WavyDivider
- **Data Display:** Toast, Tooltip, ProgressIndicator, LoadingSpinner, Calendar
- **Icons:** 80+ icons (ArrowDown, ChevronDown, SettingsGear, SearchIcon, etc.)
- **Utilities:** cn() color resolver, theme tokens (--ui-color-*, --ui-font-*, etc.)

**API Call Pattern:**
- Simple async function pattern in `/lib/plans.ts`:
  - `async function getPlans(): Promise<Plan[]>` - Server-side data fetching
  - Returns fixture data; comment indicates real app would call a billing service
  - Used with `await getPlans()` in server component (page.tsx)

**Styling & Theme:**
- **Tailwind CSS v4** with @tailwindcss/turbopack
- Design system styles imported in `/app/globals.css`:
  - `@dooph-software/design-system/styles.css`
  - `@dooph-software/design-system/theme.css`
- CSS variables for fonts (`--font-google-sans-flex`, etc.) mapped to design tokens
- Tailwind utilities like `flex`, `gap-lg`, `px-xl`, `py-xxl`, `border-border-primary`, `text-text-secondary`

**File Paths:**
- `/app/layout.tsx` - Root layout
- `/app/page.tsx` - Home page
- `/app/dashboard/page.tsx` - Dashboard page
- `/components/theme-toggle.tsx` - Theme toggle component
- `/lib/plans.ts` - Data fetching helper
- `/app/globals.css` - Global styles
- `/next.config.ts` - Next.js config
- `/tsconfig.json` - TypeScript config
